svg.title: ParetoGS: adapt sparse anchors, encode once, decode at any budget
svg.desc: Illustrative method diagram, not experimental measurements. Colored ellipses represent persistent Gaussian identities, without a target object silhouette. Twenty-four members become ten and then five; adaptation preserves each selected set. Common member states interpolate recovered endpoints, while entering members use only the upper endpoint and opacity gating. All objects and text are editable native SVG.
